definitions.gloss: doujinshi; fanzine; self-published magazine or manga
definitions.explanation: Self-published works, typically manga, novels, or magazines, created by amateur artists or writers and sold at conventions or specialty shops.

examples.japanese: コミケ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{同人誌|どうじんし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought a doujinshi at Comiket.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{趣味|しゅみ}→趣味：00889_shumi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{同人誌|どうじんし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{描|か}いている→描く：28436_kaku⟧。
examples.english: She draws doujinshi as a hobby.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{作家|さっか}→作家：01414_sakka⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{同人誌|どうじんし}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦プロ→プロ：03871_puro⟧になった。
examples.english: This artist became a professional from making doujinshi.

notes:
FORMS:
⟦{同人|どうじん}→同人：20053_doujin⟧ (same person/coterie) + {誌|し} (magazine)

CULTURAL NOTE:
{同人誌|どうじんし} is a major part of Japanese otaku culture. While originally referring to literary coterie magazines, today it primarily refers to self-published manga. Many are fan works (⟦{二次創作|にじそうさく}→二次創作：17937_nijisousaku⟧) based on existing anime, manga, or games, though original works (⟦オリジナル→オリジナル：10829_orijinaru⟧) are also common.

KEY EVENTS:
- コミケ/⟦コミック→コミック：10868_komikku⟧⟦マーケット→マーケット：00265_maaketto⟧ (Comiket - world's largest doujinshi convention)
- コミティア (Comitia - original works only)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {同人誌|どうじんし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{描|か}く→描く：28436_kaku⟧ (to draw doujinshi)
- {同人誌|どうじんし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧ (to publish doujinshi)
- {同人誌|どうじんし}{即売会|そくばいかい} (doujinshi sales event)
